title: Advanced data bulb
content:
Yes. You can reset the password directly from this wp_users table, so you don't need the email-reset system.

From your screenshot, I can see several WordPress users. Don't delete any of them.

The safest approach is to reset the password for the account you recognize. For example, the first account is:

Username: meerawork16@gmail.com
Email: meerawork16@gmail.com
ID: 1

If that is your account, we can reset its password.

Reset it from phpMyAdmin
On the row for meerawork16@gmail.com, click Edit.
Find the field named user_pass.
Delete the existing value.
Enter a new temporary password, for example:
Ark@2026NewPass!
In the Function dropdown next to user_pass, select MD5.
Scroll down and click Go/Save.

Then go to:

https://arkindustrie.com/wp-admin

Login with:

Username: meerawork16@gmail.com
Password: the new password you entered.

One important thing

Your database shows 7 WordPress accounts, including:

bot
adminbackup
administrator_6c55871b6a
uwlayowx
acadtapi
